english.title: Cause / permit a vehicle to do a U turn without authority within the Mersey Tunnels
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being

(A)_[the driver of a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), within the Mersey Tunnels, namely **(..SPECIFY THE TUNNEL..),]_
(B)_[the driver of a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), within the Mersey Tunnels approaches and marshalling areas, namely **(..SPECIFY THE TUNNEL APPROACH OR MARSHALLING AREA..),]_
(C)_[a cyclist in the Queensway Tunnel,]_
(D)_[a cyclist on the approaches to the Queensway Tunnel,]_

(E)_[caused]_
(F)_[permitted]_

(G)_[the vehicle]_
(H)_[the cycle]_

to make a U turn in the tunnels or the approaches without a direction to do so by a Mersey Tunnels police officer or other authorised officer
english.legislation: Contrary to Byelaws 3(d) and 16 of the Mersey Tunnels Byelaws 2003.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
being the driver of a vehicle within the Mersey Tunnels / approaches / marshalling areas OR
being a cyclist in the Queensway Tunnel / on the approaches to the Queensway Tunnel
caused / permitted the vehicle / cycle to make a U turn in the tunnels or the approaches
without a direction to do so by a Mersey Tunnels police officer or other authorised officer
